description: This file defines an enumeration 'SavingsWithdrawalFeesType' that categorizes different types of withdrawal fees for savings accounts, such as invalid, flat fee, and percentage of amount fee, including utility methods for value conversion.

classes.name: SavingsWithdrawalFeesType
classes.description: Enumeration for different savings withdrawal fee types, providing methods to access fee type codes and convert integers to enum instances.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the fee type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the fee type.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Provides an array of integer values for all valid fee types, excluding 'INVALID'.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding 'SavingsWithdrawalFeesType' enum, defaulting to 'INVALID' for unrecognized values.
